rationale: Material prompt requirement: A logical fact-and-dimension design covering source granularity, keys, repeated records, join expansion, shared entities, historical coverage, and late arrivals.. Comparing the complete source-visible workflow with the prompt: It usefully makes metric-definition choices explicit, recommends options, and preserves unresolved owner decisions. But it intentionally defines a KPI rather than designing the mart's fact and lookup structure, source-grain gate, and dimensional history treatment.
